messages.author: Fabian Glaser
messages.body:
Dear developers,
I am currently using amber16 and i wonder if i should upgrade to 18 or skip
it and wait to the release of amber20.
Any suggestions?
Thanks!
Fabian

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, Feb 22, 2020, Fabian Glaser wrote:
>
>I am currently using amber16 and i wonder if i should upgrade to 18 or skip
>it and wait to the release of amber20.
Amber20 will be released in April.  Those who license Amber18 now will
qualify for a free upgrade to Amber20 once it is released.
So, it's mainly a question of your time here: for experienced Amber
users, it should be pretty straightforward to install Amber18, but you
still have to fill out the license paperwork, and spend an hour or two
installing; then do the same thing in about six weeks.  Certainly worth
doing if you are having problems with Amber16 that might have been
fixed with Amber18.
...dac
